Title: Register a new customer and log in with the same credentials
Preconditions: Browser open at https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/. Email address is unique and unused.
Steps: 1. Open Sign in then Register. | 2. Enter all required fields with valid data and unique email. | 3. Submit registration. | 4. Log in with the same email and password. | 5. Open the user profile.
TestData: First name: Tes; Last name: User; DOB: age between 18 and 75; Email: qa.manual+<timestamp>@example.com; Password: Test@1234; Confirm: Test@1234; Phone and address: valid values
ExpectedResult: Account is created. Login succeeds. Profile shows the registered name and email.

Title: Reject login with an invalid password
Preconditions: Home page is loaded. Do not use customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com so the Smoke account is not locked.
Steps: 1. Open Sign in / Login. | 2. Enter a known customer email and an incorrect password. | 3. Submit login. | 4. Try to open My Invoices.
ExpectedResult: Error is shown. User remains logged out. My Invoices is not accessible without a valid session.

Title: Search for an in-stock product and open the product detail page
Steps: 1. Open https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/. | 2. Confirm product cards are listed. | 3. Search for Claw Hammer. | 4. Open the matching product from the results.
ExpectedResult: Catalog loads. Search returns matching product(s). PDP shows name, price, and Add to cart.

Title: Add two different in-stock products to the cart
Preconditions: User is logged in as customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com / welcome01. Cart is empty or noted so extra lines can be identified.
Steps: 1. Search Claw Hammer and add it to the cart from the PDP. | 2. Return to the catalog. | 3. Search Combination Pliers and add it to the cart. | 4. Open the cart.
TestData: Product A: Claw Hammer (qty 1); Product B: Combination Pliers (qty 1); User: customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com / welcome01
ExpectedResult: Cart shows two separate line items with correct names and unit prices. Cart badge or count reflects two products.

Title: Update cart quantity and verify line and cart totals
Preconditions: User is logged in. Cart contains one in-stock product at quantity 1 (Claw Hammer).
Steps: 1. Open the cart. | 2. Record unit price and line total at qty 1. | 3. Increase quantity to 2. | 4. Confirm line total and cart subtotal. | 5. Decrease quantity back to 1.
TestData: Product: Claw Hammer; Qty sequence: 1 then 2 then 1
ExpectedResult: At qty 2 the line total equals unit price x 2 and the cart subtotal updates. At qty 1 totals return to the original amounts.

Title: Complete checkout using Cash on Delivery
Preconditions: User is logged in. Cart has at least one in-stock item. Billing fields can be filled from the profile or entered manually.
Steps: 1. Open cart and proceed to checkout. | 2. Confirm order summary matches cart items and totals. | 3. Select Cash on Delivery. | 4. Complete required billing fields. | 5. Place the order.
TestData: Payment method: Cash on Delivery / cash-on-delivery; Billing: valid street city state country postal code
ExpectedResult: Checkout is accepted. Application moves to the confirm / success step. No payment-card fields are required for COD.

Title: Generate invoice with Confirm twice and verify it under My Invoices
Preconditions: TC-MAN-06 just completed (or equivalent COD checkout). User is still logged in.
Steps: 1. On the post-checkout screen click Confirm. | 2. Click Confirm a second time. | 3. Open My Invoices. | 4. Open the newest invoice. | 5. Check products quantities totals and payment method.
TestData: Confirm clicks: 2; Payment method expected: Cash on Delivery
ExpectedResult: After the second Confirm a new invoice appears in My Invoices. Detail matches the cart (items qty totals) and shows Cash on Delivery.

Title: Block COD checkout when a mandatory billing field is empty
Preconditions: User is logged in. Cart contains at least one in-stock product.
Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout with a non-empty cart. | 2. Select Cash on Delivery. | 3. Clear or leave blank one mandatory billing field (for example postal code). | 4. Attempt to place the order.
TestData: Payment method: Cash on Delivery; Postal code: (blank); Other billing fields: valid
ExpectedResult: Validation error is shown for the missing field. Order is not placed. My Invoices does not gain a new invoice from this attempt.
